name: The Hound's Trail
summary: Lucan's Thread of Fate: the Discovery.

stages.journal: Lucan is waiting for a hunt worthy of a legend. An Act II chapter will bring it to him.
stages.hint: Keep Lucan with the party, or at camp, and rest once the chapter is done.

waits.text: Lucan will want a word at camp once that chapter is behind us.

stages.journal: In the Fields of the Crow Lucan followed his hound to a kill he had not made, and looked at the hound for a long time.
